name: ollama-balance
description: Shows how many ollama.com cloud credits are left, in the status bar.

ollamaBalance.pollInterval.markdownDescription: How often to poll `ollama.com/api/balance` for the remaining credits and `ollama.com/api/usage` for spend statistics, in seconds. Failures back off x2 up to x8 of this interval; a `429` is obeyed through its `Retry-After` header.

ollamaBalance.apiKey.deprecationMessage: Not used for API calls and ignored. Keys are stored in the system keychain — run 'Ollama Balance: Set API Key…' instead. If a value is present here, the extension offers to move it over.
ollamaBalance.apiKey.markdownDescription: Deprecated. Kept only so the extension can detect a plain-text key you already put into settings.json and offer to migrate it to secure storage.
